_note: Static data for amitkuzi.github.io. Hand-maintained — nothing is fetched from the GitHub API at build or run time. Update this file and redeploy. Verified against github.com/amitkuzi?tab=repositories&type=source on 2026-08-24: 12 public, non-fork repositories.
_rules: Own repositories only. Forks never appear here.
'status' controls rendering: live = shown, hold = withheld pending a decision, hidden = deliberately excluded.
Every entry must have a real description. A repo with no description does not go on the hub — fix it on GitHub first.
No client, employer or product name may appear until Amit marks it VERIFIED in LLM/brand/facts.md.

projects.name: OneWall
projects.tagline: Parametric vase-mode bin and container customizer
projects.description: A single OpenSCAD model exposed as an interactive browser customizer. Three controllable height sections, textured wall patterns, live Three.js preview, STL export — all generated client-side.

projects.name: localViewer
projects.description: Opens Markdown, YAML, CSV, STL, 3MF, STEP, OpenSCAD and images directly in the browser. Nothing is uploaded — every file is parsed and rendered client-side. Installable as a PWA, works offline.
